## Template: Python Development

This sandbox is set up for Python development with a virtual environment.

- A Python venv is auto-created at `/workspace/.venv` and activated on startup
- Install packages with `pip install <package>` (auto-recorded)
- For web APIs: use Flask (port 5000), FastAPI/uvicorn (port 8000), or Django (port 8000)
- For data work: install pandas, numpy, matplotlib via pip
- Node.js is available if you need a frontend or build tools
